heroHeadline: Iran Reportedly Targeting US Military Bases in Germany
heroSubtitle: Day 223 (October 8, 2026): Iran is reportedly targeting US military bases in Germany, weeks after Israel warned European partners of the threat — as the Pentagon maintains heightened readiness and Iranian analysts warn the gap between diplomacy and open war is narrowing.
